description: This file implements a Zustand store for authentication state management in a React application, integrating with Supabase for auth operations. It manages user sessions, profile fetching, and auth event subscriptions, exposing methods for sign-in, sign-up, password reset, password update, and sign-out.

methods.name: fetchProfile(userId)
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to fetch a user's profile from the 'profiles' table, returns null if not present or on error.

methods.name: ensureSubscribed
methods.description: Ensures the auth store subscribes once; loads current session and sets up auth state change listener.

methods.name: initAuthWatcher
methods.description: Starts the Supabase auth watcher and initializes the store with current session/user.

methods.name: signInWithPassword
methods.description: Signs in a user with email and password via Supabase.

methods.name: signUpWithPassword
methods.description: Signs up a new user with email and password via Supabase, optionally with email redirect.

methods.name: sendPasswordReset
methods.description: Sends a password reset email to the specified address via Supabase.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the current user's password via Supabase.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current user and clears auth state.

methods.name: getAuthState()
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current authentication state captured from the store.
